job-api.json.structure: Exact Kubernetes Job JSON; terminal conditions and backoff-limit reason.

pod-api.json.structure: Exact Kubernetes Pod JSON; node assignment, image digest, container state, exit code and UIDs.

events-api.json.structure: Exact Kubernetes Events response filtered to the attempt Pod; includes scheduling-limit and placement messages.

container.log.structure: Exact bounded log text returned by the EKS log tool. The AccessDenied occurred on source-bucket ListObjectsV2 before the producer started.

terminal-receipt.json.structure: Job/Pod identity, terminal status, failure class, producer-start flag, output count, and next-attempt requirement.

DATA_INDEX.json.structure: Byte count, SHA-256, role and media type for each evidence file.

hash_rule: manifest.sha256 hashes every listed file and the two descriptors; DATA_INDEX does not hash itself.
